title: How to Generate with Scene-by-Scene Approach:
use_cases: Use when generating long-form narrative content over 5000 words
Implement when detailed control over scene pacing and continuity is required
Configure when adapting a story outline into specific prose based on distinct style notes
Use when managing state and context across multiple subsequent LLM prompts
content:
```
FIRST PROMPT:
"Here is my complete story outline: [paste filled template]
Please write Scene 1 according to the specifications. Focus especially on establishing [specific element]."

SUBSEQUENT PROMPTS:
"Here is the story outline: [paste template]
Here's what happened in previous scenes: [brief summary]
Please write Scene [X] according to the specifications. Make sure to [specific continuity note]."
```
